domains.truth: installed runtime, generations and profile under ~/.local/share/vibecrafted and ~/.vibecrafted
domains.write_surface: installer generation build + atomic generation switch

domains.truth: process, run, lifecycle and control state under ~/.vibecrafted/control_plane, including the mission-level continuity packet
agent session history, intentions and decisions
repository structure, hubs, impact and report artifacts
branded terminal emulator surface: rendering, fonts, window, branding
domains.write_surface: installed vc-terminal profile from the runtime manifest

domains.truth: tabs, layouts, panes, multiplexing and session composition
directed agent-to-agent and human-agent envelopes: ACK, correlation, dedup, heartbeat, handoff evidence
domains.write_surface: persisted outbox/inbox with cursors; ACK only after persist

domains.truth: tenants, auth state, billing tiers and feature entitlement
domains.write_surface: Polar webhooks + tenant service (loctree-com tier ladder)

domains.truth: plan artifacts (mission, atlas, briefs, tracker, reports) under $VIBECRAFTED_HOME/artifacts/<org>/<repo>/<day>/plans/
domains.write_surface: direct file writes in the artifact tree (workers, operators and the scaffold editor all write the same files; the scaffold API is a convenience client of this surface and the only path for remote integrations without filesystem access)

must_not: link installed artifacts to a repository checkout
source product logic into the host shell
delegate run truth to any UI or transport
act as a run-state store
act as a repository-structure store
act as a session-memory store
implement run or session lifecycle
duplicate vc-frame state
own run-lifecycle truth (projects the control plane)
own the terminal substrate
carry the product terminal identity
own any lifecycle
invent a parallel state model
crawl arbitrary files
reconstruct liveness heuristically
render a control without an authorized backend transition
be the source of run-lifecycle truth
execute untrusted text through a shell
emit ACK before the envelope and cursor are persisted
coexist with a second billing system
gate runtime truth
depend on any service being up for a write to count
become a required mediator for plan-artifact writes (files are the only write surface)
treat its changes/checkpoints ledger as authoritative over the plan files on disk

rules.statement: Every truth domain has exactly one owner; projections never write.
Installed artifacts never resolve to a repository checkout; repo paths appear only in development receipts.
rules.enforced_by: tests/test_ownership_contract.py + installer symlink audit (FALSIFICATION: recursive symlink and literal-path audit)

rules.statement: A resume attempt preserves identity and lineage; it never silently replaces the worker with a different persona.
Every visible control performs a real, authorized action or is absent.
rules.enforced_by: click-to-event integration tests (FALSIFICATION: controls are real)

rules.statement: Runtime gates are verified through the artifact the user actually runs.
rules.enforced_by: clean-machine artifact walk-around (FALSIFICATION: product is shippable)

rules.statement: Append-entries in plan-artifact files (tracker rows, decision addenda, journal lines) carry an inline HTML-comment provenance stamp with the same key set as commit-msg trailers. Server changes/checkpoints ledgers and AICX intents are projections of these stamps, never their source.
rules.stamp_format: <!-- provenance: source=<kind> agent=<agent> model=<model> session_id=<uuid> time=<iso8601> runtime=<runtime> -->
